تعترفون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَرِفُونَ (taʕtarifūna) /taʕ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# تُعْتَرَفُونَ (tuʕtarafūna) /tuʕ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
